title: The organisation's baseline
why: Every project this organisation runs needs an owner for failure and a runbook before it can be called live. The catalog knows what a product needs; it cannot know who answers the page.

addRequirements.title: Someone owns failure, and knows what to do first
addRequirements.statement: When the primary journey fails in production, the application shall have a named owner and a first-response step recorded in the repository, reachable without asking anyone.
addRequirements.failurePath: An incident with no named owner becomes a thread about whose turn it is while the product is down.
acceptance: Given the repository, when a new engineer looks for who owns the service, then they find a named role, a channel and the first three diagnostic steps without asking in a chat.

addGates.statement: An owner and a first-response runbook exist for the primary journey, and both name the same person or role.
